ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity (white) and 60% low-intensity (black) pixel regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on the outer halves of both lobes; the left patch is elongated horizontally, while the right patch is more ellipsoidal. Black pigmentation is dominant in the center and along the leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 38 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated topography with high-frequency, small-amplitude irregularities along the posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve geometry terminating in acute points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive white circular clusters (barnacles) located on the distal margins of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological encrustations (barnacles) at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Intermediate pixel mottling at the transition zones between pigmentation types.
